'''Ardon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] as one of [[Balmorran resistance]] leader. He was stationed in the [[Farnel Outpost]] Command Center on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was a liaison officer between the resistance and Republic, though he disliked the galactic government for abandoning Balmorra citizens during the [[Great Galactic War]]. In spite of his dissatisfaction he played a crucial role in recruiting an demolitions expert named [[Tanno Vik]] into [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="Target Acquisition" />
